hyperedges.description: All five application routes defined in src/App.tsx forming the complete navigation structure: Index, SearchResults, Compare, Category, and Product pages

hyperedges.name: Database Schema (Supabase)

hyperedges.name: Full Technology Stack

hyperedges.name: Product fallback image set (6 images)

nodes.name: ShopScout
nodes.description: The application branded as ShopScout in CLAUDE.md and index.html; a price comparison platform built with React, TypeScript, and Supabase

nodes.name: ShopCompare
nodes.description: Alternative project name used in README.md for the same price comparison platform

nodes.name: React 18
nodes.description: Frontend framework version 18 used as the UI library for the application

nodes.name: TypeScript
nodes.description: Programming language providing type safety across the codebase

nodes.name: Vite
nodes.description: Build tool and dev server for the React/TypeScript frontend

nodes.name: Supabase
nodes.description: Backend platform providing PostgreSQL database, RESTful API, and auto-generated TypeScript types

nodes.name: TanStack React Query
nodes.description: Server state management library used for data fetching with caching via useQuery/useInfiniteQuery hooks

nodes.name: React Router v6
nodes.description: Client-side routing library handling navigation between pages

nodes.name: Tailwind CSS
nodes.description: Utility-first CSS framework used for styling the application

nodes.name: shadcn/ui
nodes.description: UI component library built on Radix UI primitives, integrated with Tailwind CSS via CSS custom properties

nodes.name: next-themes
nodes.description: Library providing dark/light theme switching via CSS class toggling

nodes.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
nodes.description: Google Font loaded in index.html for the application's typography with weights 400, 500, 600, 700

nodes.name: Route Structure
nodes.description: Five-route architecture defined in src/App.tsx: Index (/), SearchResults (/search), Compare (/compare), Category (/category/:slug), Product (/product/:id)

nodes.name: / (Index page)
nodes.description: Home page with trending products, recent products, and catalog carousels

nodes.name: /search (SearchResults page)
nodes.description: Full-text product search page

nodes.name: /compare (Compare page)
nodes.description: Side-by-side variant comparison page supporting up to 4 variants

nodes.name: /category/:slug (Category page)
nodes.description: Filtered product listing page by category slug

nodes.name: /product/:id (Product page)
nodes.description: Product detail page where :id is a product_variants.id, not a products.id

nodes.name: Data Flow Three-Tier Pattern
nodes.description: Architecture pattern: lib/queries (raw Supabase queries) -> hooks (React Query wrappers) -> pages/components (consumers), enforcing separation of concerns

nodes.name: lib/queries data layer
nodes.description: Raw Supabase query functions with base select strings as template literals, filters, and pagination logic

nodes.name: hooks layer
nodes.description: React Query wrappers (useQuery/useInfiniteQuery) that consume lib/queries functions and add caching

nodes.name: pages/components consumer layer
nodes.description: Page components and UI components that consume hooks directly

nodes.name: useVariantSelectionLogic
nodes.description: Hook in Product.tsx that fetches a variant by ID then loads all sibling variants for the same product

nodes.name: extractPrimaryImage
nodes.description: Utility function from useProductVariantsWithListings.ts to extract the primary image from product_variants.images JSON

nodes.name: extractAllImages
nodes.description: Utility function from useProductVariantsWithListings.ts to extract all images from product_variants.images JSON

nodes.name: useProductVariantsWithListings
nodes.description: Hook file containing extractPrimaryImage and extractAllImages utility functions for parsing variant image JSON

nodes.name: CompareProvider
nodes.description: React context provider that stores variant IDs in localStorage under the 'tq-compare' key for the compare feature

nodes.name: NavBar
nodes.description: Navigation bar component that displays a count badge for items in the compare list

nodes.name: product_variants.images JSON format
nodes.description: Image storage format on product_variants: array of {url, type: 'main'|'other', source, scraped_at} objects. Products table has no image column.

nodes.name: Supabase !inner join syntax
nodes.description: Supabase query pattern using 'products!inner (...)' to force inner joins, where the relationship name matches the foreign key target table

nodes.name: CSS Variable Theme System
nodes.description: Theme system using HSL values via CSS custom properties (--background, --foreground, --accent) defined in src/index.css; dark class overrides for dark mode

nodes.name: tq-compare localStorage key
nodes.description: localStorage key used by CompareProvider to persist selected variant IDs for cross-session comparison

nodes.name: brands table
nodes.description: Database table for product brands and manufacturers

nodes.name: categories table
nodes.description: Database table for product categories with hierarchical structure

nodes.name: products table
nodes.description: Database table for product information and specifications

nodes.name: product_variants table
nodes.description: Database table for product variations (color, size, etc.), stores images as JSON array

nodes.name: listings table
nodes.description: Database table for price listings from different retailers, linked to variants via variant_id FK

nodes.name: JSON-LD Structured Data
nodes.description: Schema.org WebSite structured data in index.html with SearchAction for site search, targeting /?q={search_term_string}

nodes.name: graphify-out/ knowledge graph
nodes.description: Knowledge graph directory at graphify-out/ containing extracted and inferred relationships for the codebase

nodes.name: Lovable platform
nodes.description: Code generation and deployment platform at lovable.dev; source of this project and its deployment target

nodes.name: @/ path alias
nodes.description: Path alias configured to map @/ to src/ directory for imports

nodes.name: Auto-generated Supabase types
nodes.description: TypeScript types at src/integrations/supabase/types.ts auto-generated from the database schema, should not be hand-edited

nodes.name: Supabase client singleton
nodes.description: Single supabase client instance at src/integrations/supabase/client.ts, auto-generated, should not be duplicated

nodes.name: Query pattern: base select strings
nodes.description: Pattern where queries in lib/queries/ define a base select string as a template literal, then export functions building and executing Supabase queries

nodes.name: public/placeholder.svg
nodes.description: SVG placeholder image (1200x1200) used as a fallback when product variant images are unavailable. Renders a gray background with a camera/photo icon and crosshair overlay.

nodes.name: Camera/concept icon in placeholder
nodes.description: Central camera-themed icon within the placeholder: an outer circle, an inner white circle, and a camera body shape with lens, conveying 'no image' or 'image not found'.

nodes.name: Crosshair overlay lines
nodes.description: Four diagonal/horizontal/vertical gradient lines crossing the center of the placeholder, adding a crosshair or search/focus motif.

nodes.name: Product image fallback placeholder
nodes.description: The role of this SVG as the default display when a product variant has no images in its product_variants.images JSON array.

nodes.name: src/assets/prod-controller.jpg
nodes.description: JPEG image (672x512 pixels) of a gaming controller/gamepad used as a fallback/placeholder product image in the Category and RelatedProductsSection components. One of a set of six product fallback images.

nodes.name: Gaming controller/gamepad
nodes.description: The image depicts a gaming controller or gamepad, a handheld input device for video game consoles and PC gaming, with grips, buttons, D-pad and joystick areas visible.

nodes.name: Product category fallback image (controller)
nodes.description: The role of this image as one of six cyclical fallback products images in Category.tsx (line 279) and RelatedProductsSection.tsx, assigned when a product variant has no primaryImage. Used with index modulo 6 fallback rotation.

nodes.name: Six-image fallback set
nodes.description: The complete set of six fallback product images used interchangeably as placeholder visuals: headphones, sneakers, watch, laptop, controller, and coffeemaker. Cycled via index % fallbackImages.length.
